name: sistema-dece-uets
description: Sistema DECE (UETS) — portal con micro frontends y microservicios. Cada app/servicio es independiente (su propio package.json); este archivo solo orquesta el desarrollo local.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix services/identity-service install && npm --prefix services/tutoring-service install && npm --prefix services/api-gateway install && npm --prefix services/notification-service install && npm --prefix apps/portal-shell install && npm --prefix apps/tutorias-mfe install
scripts.db:setup: npm --prefix services/identity-service run prisma:deploy && npm --prefix services/identity-service run import:tutoring-users && npm --prefix services/tutoring-service run prisma:deploy && npm --prefix services/notification-service run prisma:deploy
scripts.db:migrate: npm --prefix services/identity-service run prisma:deploy && npm --prefix services/tutoring-service run prisma:deploy && npm --prefix services/notification-service run prisma:deploy
scripts.db:seed: npm --prefix services/identity-service run seed && npm --prefix services/tutoring-service run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n identity,tutoring,notif,gateway,portal,tutorias -c blue,green,red,yellow,magenta,cyan "npm --prefix services/identity-service run start:dev" "npm --prefix services/tutoring-service run start:dev" "npm --prefix services/notification-service run start:dev" "npm --prefix services/api-gateway run start:dev" "npm --prefix apps/portal-shell run dev" "npm --prefix apps/tutorias-mfe run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix services/identity-service test && npm --prefix services/tutoring-service test && npm --prefix services/notification-service test
